title: T10c — Acceptance on an owner-selected mini PC, Pi or equivalent
goal: Acceptance on an owner-selected mini PC, Pi or equivalent.
privacy: Neutral fixtures only in git; actual profiles, backups, credentials and deployment evidence remain private.
acceptance: Acceptance on an owner-selected mini PC, Pi or equivalent
Implement validated install/status/start/stop/update/uninstall/recovery for supported Linux user services with explicit account/login policy
Preserve profile/source/root ownership, fencing, backups, interruption and uncertain workers; do not enable system-wide or linger behavior implicitly
Demonstrate selected mini PC/Pi or equivalent Linux target lifecycle and reconnect; fixtures do not prove login/boot behavior
validation: Meaningful cross-boundary regressions and required final CI
Explicit selected-target acceptance where service, install or real device behavior is required; static/unit passes do not substitute
escalation: Material acceptance/effort expansion or distinct outcome splitting requires owner agreement
Never change an unowned installation, service, engine or uncertain physical effect without explicit reconciliation

effort.estimate: 0.5 focused day plus the owner run
effort.basis: Owner-approved slice, 2026-11-11 (PR #264). Slice T10c of the step "Linux service lifecycle execution and target acceptance". Estimate, not a measurement.
